title: SharePoint: chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents in Teams
summary: Hold: the briefing labels the known cost as admin time despite documenting metered SharePoint agent usage. It also overstates who can see overshared content and leaves billing applicability open where Microsoft already states the rule for .agent files. The roadmap facts and both control paths and commands are supported.
